metadata.description: Toolkit V2: plugins that set up and run one solo developer's projects in Claude Code and Codex. The agent runs the project; the owner decides and steers.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: The Toolkit V2 runtime: the toolkit command, the hooks that brief each session and check work items and memory, and the project-setup skill that sets up or repairs a project. Its hooks do nothing outside a Toolkit V2 project.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Runs a project's work items from first idea to done: nine skills and six agents for requirements, solution design, sub-items, building, checking, and shipping, with the owner approving each gate. Works with a local .work-items/ folder or Notion.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Saves, finds, and tidies what a project should remember: lasting facts, the current focus, and the glossary, in the built-in .memory/ folder, local Hindsight, or Notion.

plugins.name: session-skills
plugins.description: Five conversation skills: handoff writes a checked prompt for a new session, session-summary recaps this chat, braindump plays back a brain dump, explain-simply re-explains in plain bullets, and unslop removes machine-written patterns from text.

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Four Git skills that stay safe when several agent sessions share one repository: pull-latest, reset-to-remote, merge-and-clean-up, and publish-docs.

plugins.name: sf-architect-solutioning
plugins.description: Salesforce solution architect skill. Takes a requirement, pushes back on vagueness, verifies platform facts against official Salesforce docs (live fetch, never memory), designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces an approved solution plan before any build. Project-agnostic: discovers each project's requirement/decision locations from its own AGENTS.md and rules.
